Update marketplace APM entries pinned to branches.

description: Group APM package updates together and keep them under manual review; the built-in apm manager gives devDependencies the apm-dev type

Look up an APM dependency pinned to a commit on a branch, such as package#<sha>  # main, through git-refs. Renovate's built-in apm manager reads the comment after the commit as a release tag, and github-tags has no tag by a branch name. A comment that is a release tag (v1.2.3, 1.2.3, <name>-v1.2.3, or <path>/v1.2.3, with an optional prerelease or build suffix) stays a tag lookup. git versioning keeps a digit in a branch name, as in release/1.2.0 or lts/26.1, from being read as a version

Compare an APM dependency on a path-prefixed release tag, such as package#<sha>  # foo/v1.2.3, only with the tags that share the prefix, and write the prefix back. Monorepos tag each package this way, and a Go module in a subdirectory requires <dir>/v1.2.3
Branch-tracked APM refs use git-refs, which has no release timestamp; skip the release-age delay and rely on manual review
